title: Silver Star Christmas Gift Box Lights, 3-Piece Illuminated Present Decorations with Warm White LEDs, 8 Flashing Modes, Remote Control and Battery Box, Indoor Holiday Home Decor
bullets: THREE-PIECE SILVER STAR SET: Create a warm seasonal display with three illuminated gift boxes in the Silver Star design. The translucent star-pattern fabric lets the warm white LEDs glow through for a festive Christmas look.

WARM LED DECORATION: Place the glowing present boxes on a mantel, console, dining table, entryway shelf or reading nook. Arrange the three sizes together as a centrepiece or spread them through one room.

EIGHT LIGHTING MODES: The supplier lists a remote-controlled battery box with eight adjustable flashing modes. Select a steady or changing light effect to suit your holiday display; operation and remote range should be checked on the delivered set.

BATTERY-POWERED DISPLAY: Supplier details state 4.5 V power from three AA batteries and a manual switch. Batteries are not confirmed as included, so check the package before listing this as ready to use.

SEASONAL HOME DECOR: Designed for Christmas decoration and indoor seasonal styling. The supplier lists IP44; keep the battery box dry and use the set in a sheltered location unless the delivered instructions confirm other conditions.
